match_running: A match for this project is running.
match_no_spec: Choose a spec to match first.
connection_hint: The connection the matcher reads your specification on.
model_hint: Another connection starts on its own default model.
sent_to: Requests go to {host}. The key stays on the server and is never shown here.
spec_hint: A Markdown file. One in the Constructor Fabric format is read as it is; any other is read by the model first, which spends extra calls.
spec_too_large: That file is over 500 KB, which is more than the matcher takes.
spec_unreadable: That file could not be read.
none_note: Choose a specification, then Match to Gears. It lists the Gears that cover each requirement.
partial_note: Some requirements could not be assessed. Matching again re-asks only those.
